A '''''lopinginny''''' is a type of bird found in the [[Aiel Waste]].

Given the comparison made by Gaul between [[Lord Luc]] as he initially appeared in the [[Two Rivers]] and the bird, lopinginnies likely act aggressively, but flee when there is real danger.{{ref/book|14|14}} The Companion defines it as "a bird found in the Waste with a bold call, though it was not a bold bird".{{ref|{{twotc}}, lopinginny}} 

{{quote|“It is a type of bird,” Gaul said. “From the Three-fold Land. I did not see this man often, but he seemed to be the type who talked big, but was inwardly a coward.”|Gaul, A Memory of Light}}
